marks.gloss_en: אמר קרא חיה או עוף -- מה חיה אינה קדש, אף עוף אינו קדש: as the chaya [of the covering verse] is not consecrated, so the bird is not consecrated
אי מה חיה שאין במינו קדש, אף עוף שאין במינו קדש -- אוציא תורין ובני יונה, שיש במינן קדש: the proposed extension excluding even unconsecrated turtledoves and pigeons
לא, כחיה -- מה חיה לא חלקת בה, אף עוף לא תחלוק בו: no -- like the chaya, in which you made no division [by kind], make none in the bird
מכאן אמר רבי אלעזר בן עזריה -- from 'of your herd, and not all your herd'
R' Elazar ben Azarya: one who has a maneh buys a litra of vegetables for his pot; ten maneh, a litra of fish; fifty maneh, a litra of meat; a hundred maneh, a pot is set for him every day
והשתא דאתית להכי, אפילו תימא קדשי מזבח -- יצא זה שמחוסר שפיכה גרירה וכסוי (= p_veshafach_vechisa_mechusar_gerira)
now that you have come to this, even say altar consecrations -- excluded is this, which lacks pouring, scraping and covering
וליפרקינהו וליכסינהו? -- let them be redeemed [after slaughter] and their blood covered
בעינן העמדה והערכה (= p_baeinan_haamada)
[a slaughtered bird cannot be redeemed:] we require standing and valuing
אמר ליה: עליך אמר קרא על הארץ תשפכנו כמים -- the verse itself compares the behema's blood to water, which needs no covering
Rava: against you the verse says 'you shall pour it on the ground like water' (Deut 12:24) -- as water needs no covering, this too needs no covering
אלא מעתה, יטבילו בו? -- if the blood is like water, let impure things be immersed in it
אך מעין ובור מקוה מים יהיה טהור -- הני אין, מידי אחרינא לא (= p_ach_mayan_hanei_in)
the verse says 'but a spring or a cistern, a gathering of water, shall be pure' (Lev 11:36) -- these yes, anything else no [so blood does not purify]
ואימא הני מילי למעוטי שאר משקין דלא איקרו מים, אבל דם דאיקרי מים הכי נמי -- the exclusion may be only of liquids not called water
תרי מיעוטי כתיבי: מעין מים, ובור מים (= p_trei_miutei)
two exclusions are written: 'a spring of water' and 'a cistern of water'
אימא אידי ואידי למעוטי שאר משקין, חד למעוטי זוחלין וחד למעוטי מכונסין -- both may exclude other liquids, one flowing and one gathered
תלתא מיעוטי כתיבי: מעין מים, ובור מים, מקוה מים (= p_tlata_miutei)
three exclusions are written: 'a spring of water', 'a cistern of water', 'a gathering of water'
האמר שחיטה שאינה ראויה שמה שחיטה -- but he says unfit slaughter is slaughter, so it would be covered
R' Meir: all [consecrations, Temple-maintenance included] were included in standing and valuing
האמר לא היו בכלל העמדה והערכה -- but he says they were not included, so let them be redeemed and covered
R' Shimon: a slaughter that is not fit is not called slaughter
Rav Yosef: it is Rebbi, taking it according to [different] tannaim -- on unfit slaughter he holds like R' Shimon, on standing and valuing like R' Meir
here it is different, for the verse says 'and he shall pour out and cover' -- one lacking only pouring and covering; excluded is this, which lacks pouring, redemption and covering
Yaakov Mina'a: we hold that the chaya is included in behema for the [kashrut] signs
the baraita: 'who traps' -- what of those already trapped of themselves, like geese and chickens? 'a trapping' -- in any case
the baraita: 'when the Lord your God expands your border' (Deut 12:20) -- the Torah taught that a person should eat meat only from appetite
the baraita: might one buy [meat] from the market and eat? 'and you shall slaughter of your herd and your flock' (Deut 12:21)
Rav: we must be concerned for the words of the elder
'lambs for your clothing' (Prov 27:26) -- from the shearing of lambs let your clothing be
'for your bread, for the bread of your house' (Prov 27:27) -- your bread comes before the bread of your house
